recapture.title: Evidence recapture
recapture.loadFailed: The evidence recapture could not be loaded.
recapture.mismatch: This evidence recapture belongs to another product.
recapture.notice: These captures do not publish or replace the product enrichment.
recapture.olderRun: The recapture was made on an earlier enrichment; check the values at the source before comparing.

notFound.title: Product not found
notFound.description: This GTIN is not in the current catalog.

queue.empty: No other product in the review queue
queue.afterDecision: Approving or rejecting opens the next product of the review queue.

contentLanguage.tooltip: Language the enrichment was written in. Changing Settings does not rewrite existing products; re-enrich them explicitly.

attributes.title: Technical attributes
attributes.subtitle: Compare the proposed value with the original source before approving or editing.
attributes.auditDescription: “View audit” shows the source page, the captured excerpt and the source type, and lets you attach manual evidence (URL and excerpt, or a screenshot). Every edit needs its own evidence.

empty.title: No attributes
empty.description: The attribute matrix has no attributes for this subcategory.

edit.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why the value is being changed
edit.evidenceRequired: Required: prove the new value with a screenshot, or with the source URL and excerpt.

rejection.NO_EVIDENCE_FOR_CANDIDATE: A candidate was kept, but no extracted evidence supports the value.
rejection.EVIDENCE_VALUE_MISMATCH: The candidate differs from the value its own source states; check both before publishing.
rejection.NOT_IN_VOCABULARY: The value found at the source is not in the attribute vocabulary.
rejection.TAXONOMY_MISMATCH: Removed: a taxonomy attribute must match the product's category or subcategory exactly.

applicability.CANDIDATE_NEEDS_REVIEW: There is a candidate that needs human validation.
applicability.EVIDENCE_FOUND: The research found evidence for this attribute.
applicability.OPTIONAL_NO_CANDIDATE: Optional attribute with no candidate or evidence for this product.
applicability.NOT_IN_MATRIX: The attribute is not in the applicable matrix or was marked as not applicable.

evidence.title: Facts and sources
evidence.empty: No facts were researched for this product yet.

review.title: Review decision
review.staleDecision: The previous decision ({{status}}) was made on an older enrichment result. Review this result and decide again.

history.title: History

events.ATTRIBUTE_OVERRIDE_SUPERSEDED: Edit replaced by a newer one

history.reopenedReason: An edit or evidence changed after the approval, so the product needs a new decision.

evidenceForm.excerptPlaceholder: Copy the text of the page that shows the value
evidenceForm.fileHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 10 MB. You can also paste with Ctrl+V.
evidenceForm.notePlaceholder: Context for whoever audits this later

problems.imageType: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
problems.imageSize: The screenshot must be at most 10 MB.
problems.https: The source URL must start with https://.
problems.missing: Attach a screenshot, or enter the source URL and the excerpt that proves the value.

crop.failed: The crop could not be loaded. The file may be unavailable or you may not have access to it.

page.failed: The page screenshot could not be loaded. The file may be unavailable or you may not have access to it.

manual.failed: The uploaded screenshot could not be loaded. The file may be unavailable or you may not have access to it.

audit.title: Audit of {{attribute}}
audit.description: Check the proposed value and the sources behind it before approving or editing.
audit.overrideNote: The sources below support the original AI value; the manual evidence supports this edit.

restoreDialog.title: Restore the original AI value?
restoreDialog.description: The edit “{{edited}}” will be removed and the attribute will show “{{original}}” again. The history stays available in the product audit.

sources.title: Sources consulted
sources.description: Check the preserved capture. The original page may have changed since it was consulted.

capture.NOT_VISIBLE: The page does not display the value — review needed
capture.NO_MATCH: Value not found in the capture — review needed
capture.AMBIGUOUS: The value appears in more than one place — review needed
capture.SCREENSHOT_ONLY: The page changed during the capture — check the full screenshot
capture.UNSUPPORTED: Source without visual capture (PDF) — review needed

audit.noExcerpt: The URL is linked to the attribute, but no excerpt was captured for this reference.
audit.noCropSeePage: There is no clear, unambiguous crop of this value. Check the value in the page screenshot below.
audit.noCropTextKept: There is no clear, unambiguous crop of this value. The text evidence was preserved.
audit.noUrls: No URL is linked to this attribute. Do not approve a filled value without validating an external source.

manual.title: Manual evidence
manual.forEdit: Proof attached by reviewers for the edited value.
manual.forAi: Proof attached by reviewers for the AI value.

loadFailed.title: This product could not be loaded
loadFailed.description: The catalog did not answer. Try again in a moment.
